# ManiSkill 3 package source

Source project: https://github.com/mani-skill/ManiSkill

Package: `mani_skill` version `3.0.1`, extracted from the published `mani_skill-3.0.1-py3-none-any.whl` package without Git metadata. The original package license is in `LICENSE`, and dependency metadata is in `PACKAGE_METADATA.txt`. The package's bundled assets retain their own license files.

This source copy is independent of the Docker image's installed ManiSkill environment. The image already provides ManiSkill 3.0.1, SAPIEN, Gymnasium, and other runtime dependencies in `/root/miniconda3/envs/maniskill`.
